body: http_extract_json_string_field was skipping backslash escapes instead of decoding them, corrupting every multi-line MUD response (\r\n became literal 'rn'). This silently broke combat-log line-splitting and the new damage-popup feature. Fixed to decode real JSON escapes to real bytes; verified via unit test (byte-level CRLF check) and live Xvfb end-to-end test (clean combat log, correct damage popups, real worm kill). All temp instrumentation and disposable test characters cleaned up.
title: Fixed JSON escape decoding bug in http_client.h
